source.limitations: Transcribed from the Putnam County Health Department Septage Haulers PDF (SEWAGEHAULER-06-08-2026.pdf; footer 06/08/2026 on both pages; Page 2 prints 16 TOTAL), linked as Putnam County Registered Septic Haulers/Pumpers from the Sewage page (https://putnamhealth.com/services/sewage/). Publisher block on the PDF: 256 WILLIAMSTOWN ROAD, OTTAWA, OH 45875, Phone 1-419-523-5608, Fax 1-419-523-4171. HDIS text-layer file (Title HDIS PDF, Author HDIS Sewage Treatment, CreationDate 2026-06-08 19:13:20 UTC, 2 pages, page rotation 0, 8842 bytes). The archived .txt is the pdftotext -layout extract and still shows Brinkman's printed leading hyphen and the truncated last firm name. Spellings kept as printed, including ALL SERVICE AERATION, INC with no period after INC, operator BUETTNER, JASON last-name-first, HORSE'S SANITATION SERVICES LLC with the apostrophe and the plural SERVICES, FUSIONSITE OHIO LLC DBA C & L SANITATION and operator TOM & ROBIN L STANGE, and the truncated last firm name UNITED RENTALS (NORTH AMERICA), INC.; DBA: RE kept exactly (not completed from another county list). Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. Phones are shown as printed apart from a stray leading hyphen the HDIS export adds on Brinkman Sanitation Rentals; no digits were added or changed (visible and stored 419-523-3726, not -419-523-3726 and not 1-419-523-3726). ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). The Registered Septic System Installers PDF and the Registered Septic System Service Providers PDF on the parent page were not transcribed and were not merged. The older 28 October 2024 combined service-provider/hauler PDF still in the media library was not used. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with the Putnam County Health Department and ODH before you hire.
